description: Chapter 6 - Angular momentum. A book-led sequence for commutation relations, angular-momentum algebra, consequences, matrix and position-space representations, Schrödinger uncertainty and exercises.

topics.title: Angular momentum: chapter roadmap
topics.note: Chapter 6 introduces the formal algebra of angular momentum, for orbital or spin angular momentum, and prepares the addition of angular momenta.

topics.title: Commutation relations and Levi-Civita notation
topics.note: The main angular-momentum commutator is stated first; the vector-product definition, Levi-Civita notation and physical consequence then explain the algebraic route.

topics.title: Angular momentum algebra
topics.note: The algebra introduces L squared, the compatible pair L squared and Lz, raising/lowering operators, finite ladders and the allowed l,m spectrum.

topics.title: Consequences of the algebra
topics.note: Once Lz is definite, the transverse means vanish while their variances remain finite; the angular-momentum cone visualizes this result.

topics.title: Matrix representation
topics.note: The angular-momentum matrices are built from matrix elements in the fixed-l basis; the l equals 1 example includes the change-of-basis matrix U.

topics.title: Position-space representation
topics.note: The position-space form comes from p equals minus i hbar nabla; spherical harmonics recover the L squared and Lz eigenvalue equations.

topics.title: Schrödinger uncertainty and Schwartz inequality
topics.note: Derives the Schwartz inequality, the Schrödinger uncertainty principle and its angular-momentum form.

topics.title: Chapter synthesis: angular momentum toolkit
topics.note: The chapter summary gathers the commutator, compatible observables, ladder spectrum, representations and uncertainty relations needed for exercises.
